correctness.rationale: Transport u⋆v=T_lambda(u)T_mu(v) is verified on basis elements. J is nilpotent, so no nonzero augmentation-zero idempotents exist. U=1+J is an elementary abelian p-group and, through the C-stable filtration 1+J^k, has the same F_p[C]-character multiplicities as additive J. Additive J is f*(p^d-1)/(p-1) copies of the regular representation of F_p^×. Componentwise idempotency forces exactly lambda^j+mu^j=1; the remaining factor choices all work. Counting and induced quandle operations follow. Direct exhaustive counts and separate modular linear-rank checks agree.

value.rationale: A complete finite-field modular idempotent classification for every admissible scalar, prime, dimension, and field extension, with canonical eigenspace factors and full induced-quandle isomorphism type, answers a motivated question beyond the integral/complex quandle-ring literature. The p=7 scalar jump from eight to fifty idempotents already in dimension one shows nontrivial structural arithmetic dependence; higher-dimensional counts grow at an explicitly determined projective-line rate. Not a parameter-renaming or table recomputation.
